authority.label: Authority impersonation
authority.advice: Real banks, police and companies never mind if you hang up and call them back on their official number.

urgency.label: Urgency / deadline
urgency.advice: Pressure to act within minutes is designed to stop you thinking. Take your time.

threat.label: Threat / fear
threat.advice: No real authority arrests people or settles cases over a phone or video call.

isolation.label: Isolation / secrecy
isolation.phrase: wants you to keep it secret
isolation.advice: Anyone who tells you not to talk to your family or bank is hiding something. Tell someone now.

payment.label: Unusual payment demand
payment.phrase: is asking for an unusual payment
payment.advice: There is no such thing as a 'safe account', and no real official takes gift cards or crypto.

credentials.label: Credential request
credentials.phrase: asked for a code, PIN or password
credentials.advice: Never share an OTP, PIN or password. You never need a PIN to receive money.

remote_access.label: Remote access request
remote_access.advice: Do not install apps or share your screen at a caller's request.

reward.label: Too-good-to-be-true reward
reward.advice: Guaranteed returns and prizes that need a fee first are always scams.

trust_building.label: Trust building
trust_building.phrase: is pushing hard for your trust
trust_building.advice: Strangers who quickly ask for trust usually ask for money next.

channel_switch.label: Channel switching
channel_switch.phrase: wants to move to another app
channel_switch.advice: Scammers move you to WhatsApp or Telegram to avoid platform protections.

family_impersonation.label: Family / friend impersonation
family_impersonation.phrase: claims to be family on a new number
family_impersonation.advice: Call your family member on the number you already have for them before sending anything.

ai_manipulation.label: Attempt to fool the safety system
ai_manipulation.phrase: tried to trick the safety system
ai_manipulation.advice: Genuine callers never address an AI assistant. This is a strong scam signal.

scam_types.upi_receive: 'Enter your PIN to receive money' scam
